models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.detail: Smallest model that still works for Korean / English / Japanese / Thai language exchange. About 5 GB.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.detail: Smaller than E4B. Use only if you want the tiniest file; Korean/Japanese/Thai get thinner.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B
models.detail: Newer than Gemma 3. MoE, strong Korean / English / Japanese / Thai. Reuses the copy already in LM Studio if present.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B
models.detail: Largest Gemma 4 text model. Comfortable on a 48 GB Mac. Reuses the LM Studio copy if present.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.detail: Fastest Gemma 3 download. Fine for short Korean, English, and Japanese captions; Thai is usable.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B
models.detail: Step up from E4B if short language-exchange lines still come out thin.

models.name: Gemma 3 27B
models.detail: Highest quality Gemma 3. Use Gemma 4 26B/31B instead if those are already on disk.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.detail: Strong Korean, Japanese, and English. Thai is weaker than Gemma 3 or 4.
